openings.claim: Pre-counted staging/silhouette positions may reduce selection errors and switching effort.
openings.discriminator: Selection/checking improves, insertion unchanged; include preparation/reset labor.
openings.fit: Conditional: bench space, distinguishable shapes, global limits.
openings.probe: Both workers counterbalance matched current/staged mixed sequences on six samples across layouts/colors; time phases and independently audit contents.

openings.claim: Ordered-layout maps locating short partitions may improve comprehension; share staging/map identities.
openings.discriminator: Separate placement questions/errors from physical insertion failures.
openings.fit: Conditional: replace existing sheet within limits.
openings.probe: Randomize ten customers five per diagram, matching layouts and complete kits; measure ten-minute unaided success.

openings.discriminator: Identical parts/slots improve short-first versus short-last; sequence-independent difficulty weakens hypothesis.
openings.fit: Conditional: feasible sequences, removability, global limits.
openings.probe: Counterbalance workers/layouts/sequences and first-use wear; track identities, retries/time; check dismantling/rearrangement.
openings.uncertainty: Overlapping widths weaken width-only attribution; slot geometry/orientation remain possible.

lineage.reason: Checking and shared instruction identities preserved.

decision: Screen within 15 samples total. Preserve assembled delivery, 30x20 footprint, capacity, removable partitions, accepted counts/colors and deadline; enforce 500 initial/0.40 recurring caps. Synthetic evidence proves no target: verify 98% completeness, median <=8 minutes and 90% unaided success in the 60-unit pilot.
